title: The Reviving Hands
summary: Healing grants Blade Ward, and the gloves cast Revivify.

fields.Aegis Palms: Healing yourself or another creature grants the recipient Blade Ward for 2 turns, resisting Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing. Revivify on a Downed ally grants Death Ward for 2 turns. The source reports no Death Ward on reviving an already dead ally. This special ward can trigger repeatedly during its duration, restoring 1 HP instead of dropping to 0.
fields.Revivify: Level 3, Action once per Long Rest. Target an eligible Dead or Downed companion within 30 ft. Bring them back with 1 HP and optionally relocate them within range. Blocked resurrection tags still apply.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
